clue.text: Trend-chasing youths, good sorts, taking MDMA by north-eastern counter

indicators.note: counter means running the opposite way, so the pair of words just before it is read backwards
taking means swallowing up, so the good sorts hold the other letters inside them

blocks.note: MDMA is the drug ecstasy, abbreviated E
taken as written
standard abbreviation for north-east
toppers is old-fashioned British slang for decent, likeable people

explanation.surface: Fashion-following kids, nice enough really, are buying ecstasy from a dealer's counter in the North East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Counter' looks like a shop counter in the surface, but it signals running backwards. Toppers is dated British slang for good chaps.
explanation.definitionFit: Teenyboppers are young teenagers who slavishly follow the latest pop music and fashion fads.

explanation.definitionFit: An earplug is a stopper placed in the ear to block out sound.
